summary: Verified fix for registration bugs: (1) landing-page 'Registreren' button in top header now opens the orange 4-step MobileRegisterWizard, (2) the wizard sends `slug` to POST /api/auth/register so the Dutch error 'Slug (portal-URL) is verplicht' no longer fires. All 4 requested scenarios pass.

scenario_1_landing_topheader_register.evidence: Click [data-testid=topheader-register] opens MobileRegisterWizard. Filled 4 steps (company='Regtest <ts>', unique email, country NL, plan starter) → register-success-continue appeared → clicking continue navigated to /<slug>/admin (Setup Wizard rendered, confirming authenticated admin portal load). Slug matched slugified company name (regtest-<ts>).

scenario_2_pricing_cta_preselected_plan.evidence: Click [data-testid=plan-cta-professional] opened MobileRegisterWizard with header badge 'U KOOS: PROFESSIONAL' preselected. Full wizard submit succeeded with no slug error.

scenario_3_login_switch_mode_register.evidence: On /login, clicking [data-testid=auth-switch-mode] opened the same MobileRegisterWizard (header shows 'U KOOS: STARTER'). Completed 4 steps, submission succeeded and user was redirected to /<slug>/admin (Setup Wizard rendered for new company LoginReg <ts>). No 'Slug verplicht' error.

scenario_4_backend_slug_validation.evidence: POST /api/auth/register without `slug` + with company_name returns 400 with Dutch detail 'Slug (portal-URL) is verplicht — kies een unieke naam voor uw portal.' POST with valid slug returns 200 and company.slug matches submitted slug. Public /api/public/companies/<slug>/available correctly reports available=false afterwards. See pytest results: 2/2 passed.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileAuthShell.jsx MobileRegisterWizard duplicates slugify + availability-check logic that already lives in EmailLogin.jsx — consider extracting a usePortalSlug(companyName) hook to keep both forms in sync and avoid future drift.

MarketingLandingV2.jsx TopHeader onRegister handler was previously vulnerable to accidental event-arg leakage; wrapping with `() => onRegister()` is correct — same defensive wrapping could be applied to all other handler callsites that forward optional args (planId) to prevent regression.
test_credentials: N/A — created unique accounts: regtest+<ts>@example.com / secret123 across runs
seed_data_creation: Created 3 trial companies via self-service register during testing (slugs: regtest-<ts>, pricingreg-<ts>, loginreg-<ts>). Harmless trial tenants; can be deleted if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register wizard testids: register-company, register-name, register-email, register-password, register-country-nl, register-country-sr, register-plan-<id>, register-next, register-back, register-close, register-success-continue, register-error. Pricing plan CTAs: plan-cta-starter/professional/enterprise/lifetime (click opens wizard with that plan preselected, shown in header badge 'U KOOS: <PLAN>'). /login register entry: [data-testid=auth-switch-mode] opens same wizard. Backend /api/auth/register requires slug when company_name is provided (returns 400 Dutch error) — frontend now always sends portalPreview.slug. After success, user is auto-logged-in and routed to /<slug>/admin where Setup Wizard appears for first-time setup.
rca of the issue: Two independent bugs: (1) <TopHeader> onClick was previously passing the React synthetic event as planId to onRegister, which breaks the handler. Now wrapped as `() => onRegister()`. (2) Both MobileRegisterWizard.submit() and EmailLogin register-mode submit were not forwarding `slug` to POST /api/auth/register; backend validation (which requires explicit slug when company_name is set) therefore returned 400 'Slug (portal-URL) is verplicht'. Fix: both callsites now pass `slug: portalPreview.slug` in the register payload. Verified via UI (3 flows) and direct API (2 pytest cases).
